meta.title: Gogh Editor × WooCommerce
meta.description: The Yellow House with a real shop — gogh paints the pages, WooCommerce sells the prints.
meta.author: jamiemarsland

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
// blueprint.json is CDN-cached for a week wherever it's linked — so the
// living boot code is fetched fresh from the repo (raw caches ~5 minutes).
// If the fetch fails, fall back to whatever this cached copy knows.
$boot = false;
try {
	$boot = file_get_contents( 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jamiemarsland/gogh-editor/main/demo-boot.php' );
} catch ( \Throwable $e ) {}
if ( $boot && false !== strpos( $boot, 'gogh' ) ) {
	eval( '?>' . $boot );
} else {
	wp_set_current_user( 1 );
	try {
		$req = new WP_REST_Request( 'POST', '/gogh/v1/starter' );
		$req->set_param( 'slug', 'yellow-house' );
		rest_do_request( $req );
	} catch ( \Throwable $e ) {}
}

<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
// woo extras ride the same evergreen pattern: fetched fresh, evaluated,
// with an inline fallback that at least restores Woo's own pages.
$boot = false;
try {
	$boot = file_get_contents( 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jamiemarsland/gogh-editor/main/demo-boot-woo.php' );
} catch ( \Throwable $e ) {}
if ( $boot && false !== strpos( $boot, 'gogh' ) ) {
	eval( '?>' . $boot );
} elseif ( class_exists( 'WC_Install' ) ) {
	wp_set_current_user( 1 );
	try { WC_Install::create_pages(); } catch ( \Throwable $e ) {}
}
